shared.input: verified canonical task, CTO plan digest, exact development grant, bounded assignment, repository baseline, selected model
shared.output: alfred.developer-report/1 with file hashes, checks, commit references and QA handoff
shared.execution: one authorized isolated worktree per assignment; no host shell or network credential inheritance
shared.handoff: report completed to QA only after independent artifact inspection; blocked or failed returns to CTO
limits: no GitHub push, PR, merge or deployment
no independent scope or model escalation

frontend.name: Frontend Developer
frontend.responsibilities: Browser UI, styles, accessibility, client behavior

backend.name: Backend Developer
backend.responsibilities: API, services and database changes through the shared database capability

full_stack.name: Full-Stack Developer
full_stack.responsibilities: Coherent UI and service feature when layers are tightly coupled

devops.name: DevOps Engineer
devops.responsibilities: Build, CI and deployment configuration; never execute deployment

data_engineer.name: Data Engineer
data_engineer.responsibilities: Data pipelines, schemas and database engineering

ai_ml.name: AI & ML Developer
ai_ml.responsibilities: Model and agent pipeline implementation and evaluation

integration.name: Integration Engineer
integration.responsibilities: Service boundaries, adapters and retry behavior

security.name: Security Engineer
security.responsibilities: Implement scoped security controls; independent security review remains separate

builder.name: Builder
builder.responsibilities: General builder for Alfred gateway work, bug fixes and small features; reproduce with a failing test first, then make the smallest safe change

qa.name: QA Engineer
qa.responsibilities: Independent QA: automated and manual tests and test evidence against every acceptance criterion; implements tests, never the feature under test; does not replace the Independent QA stage

code_reviewer.name: Code Reviewer
code_reviewer.responsibilities: Independent technical, security and architecture review that approves or requests changes; never reviews its own work; does not replace the Independent Reviewer stage
deliverables: review findings with approve or request-changes decision
testing: findings tied to file and line

database_engineering.responsibilities: schema design, query behavior, migration safety
